identity.thesis_zh: 让人、辅助器具与不同厂商机器人读取同一套公共地面状态；机器进入公共空间，必须遵守居民看得懂的规则。
identity.thesis_en: Let people, mobility aids and robots from different vendors read the same public-ground states; machines entering public space must obey rules residents can understand.
identity.logo_direction_zh: 铁路枕木的平行节奏与开放括号组合为可延展字标；括号表示公共规则仍可被讨论和修订。
identity.logo_direction_en: Parallel railway-sleeper rhythm combines with an open bracket; the bracket signals that public rules remain discussable and revisable.

translations.principle_zh: 高对比轮廓、方向和编号，远看先识别状态类别。
translations.principle_en: High-contrast outline, direction and identifier reveal the state category at a glance.

translations.principle_zh: 与法定盲道可明确区分的低复杂度触感；形态必须由无障碍共创和材料试验确定。
translations.principle_en: A low-complexity texture clearly distinguishable from statutory tactile paving; final form requires accessibility co-design and material tests.

translations.principle_zh: 开放、被动、无身份载荷的视觉校验码；未知、冲突或遮挡即停止并请求人工复核。
translations.principle_en: An open, passive visual checksum with no identity payload; unknown, conflicting or occluded states trigger stop and human review.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 沿此连续方向通行；不表达优先权。
glyphs.public_state_en: Continue along this direction; it grants no priority.
glyphs.visual_zh: 双轨之间的一条连续开放线。
glyphs.visual_en: One continuous open line between paired rails.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选连续浅肋，仅在与盲道无混淆后使用。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate continuous shallow rib, usable only after non-confusion with tactile paving is proven.
glyphs.machine_zh: 方向向量、版本和校验位，不含目的地或身份。
glyphs.machine_en: Direction vector, version and checksum; no destination or identity.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 低速循线并持续让行；识别置信度不足即停。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Follow slowly while continuously yielding; stop when confidence is insufficient.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 停止在净空外，亮起可见状态并请求人工处理。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: Stop outside the clear path, show a visible state and request human handling.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 线段中断、褪色、积水、积雪或触感磨耗超过试验阈值。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Broken continuity, fading, ponding, snow cover or tactile wear beyond the tested threshold.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 不替代人行道、盲道、交通标线或导向标识。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Does not replace footways, tactile paving, traffic markings or wayfinding signs.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 机器和服务流程在此把通行权交还给人。
glyphs.public_state_en: Machines and service flows return priority to people here.
glyphs.visual_zh: 向内收束后打开的缺口。
glyphs.visual_en: An inward taper that opens into a gap.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选断续横肋，必须避开法定警示铺装语义。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate interrupted transverse rib, kept distinct from statutory warning paving.
glyphs.machine_zh: 强制减速—停车—确认净空的公共状态。
glyphs.machine_en: Public state requiring slow, stop and clear-path confirmation.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 在标记前完全停车；行人、轮椅和盲杖使用者始终优先。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Stop fully before the marker; pedestrians, wheelchair and cane users always have priority.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 无法确认净空时保持停止，不绕入无障碍通道。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: Remain stopped when clearance cannot be confirmed; never divert into the accessible path.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 停车位置不可读、表面翘起或净空被占用。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Unreadable stop location, raised surface or occupied clear space.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 只补充公共空间礼让，不替代法定让行标线或信号。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Adds public-space yielding only; never replaces statutory yield markings or signals.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 这里是不可越过或需人工确认的边界。
glyphs.public_state_en: This is a boundary that must not be crossed or requires human confirmation.
glyphs.visual_en: Double line with a closed end cap.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选平滑—粗糙转换带，不形成绊倒高差。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate smooth-to-textured transition with no trip-producing level change.
glyphs.machine_zh: 禁止越界或仅授权监督测试。
glyphs.machine_en: No crossing, or supervised-test authorization only.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 不得跨越；收到远程指令也须满足现场规则。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Do not cross; remote instructions remain subordinate to on-site rules.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 边界损坏或歧义时扩大安全停距。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: Increase stopping distance when the edge is damaged or ambiguous.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 边界连续性破坏、临时围挡改变或周边法定设施调整。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Broken boundary continuity, changed temporary barriers or altered statutory infrastructure.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 不代表地块、道路红线、文保线或法律边界。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Does not represent parcels, road redlines, heritage controls or legal boundaries.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 短时停靠、装卸或交接应收纳在此，不占连续通行净空。
glyphs.public_state_en: Short stops, loading or handover belong here, outside the continuous clear path.
glyphs.visual_zh: 朝通行线外侧打开的口袋。
glyphs.visual_en: A pocket opening away from the travel line.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选边缘节律提示，轮椅可平顺跨越。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate edge rhythm that remains flush for wheelchairs.
glyphs.machine_zh: 停靠编号、允许状态和最大占用时段，不含收件人信息。
glyphs.machine_en: Berth identifier, permitted state and maximum dwell category; no recipient data.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 仅在泊位空闲且交接人确认时进入；满位则离开通行线等待。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Enter only when the berth is clear and handover is confirmed; otherwise wait away from the travel line.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 交接失败或泊位占用时退出，不在盲道、坡道或出入口停留。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: Withdraw when handover fails or the berth is occupied; never wait on tactile paving, ramps or entrances.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 净空被家具、车辆或积雪占用，编号不可读。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Clear space occupied by furniture, vehicles or snow, or identifier unreadable.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 不构成停车、装卸或经营许可。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Does not constitute parking, loading or business permission.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 任何人可在此获得不依赖手机的人工帮助或报告问题。
glyphs.public_state_en: Anyone can obtain phone-free human help or report a problem here.
glyphs.visual_zh: 开放括号包围一个空心点。
glyphs.visual_en: An open bracket around a hollow point.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选短触感环与固定扶靠面相邻。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate short tactile ring adjacent to a fixed leaning/support surface.
glyphs.machine_zh: 只广播帮助点类别和开放状态，不采集求助者身份。
glyphs.machine_en: Broadcasts help-point class and availability only; no helper identity is collected.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 停在净空外，显示求助状态并呼叫值守角色。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Stop outside the clear path, display the help state and call the duty role.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 数字链路失效时仍保留清晰的物理求助方向和人工渠道。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: If digital links fail, retain clear physical directions and a human channel.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 人工渠道不可用、标记被遮挡或方向错误。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Human channel unavailable, marker obscured or direction wrong.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 不替代报警、消防、医疗急救或法定无障碍服务。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Does not replace police, fire, medical emergency or statutory accessibility services.

glyphs.public_state_zh: 前方规则、路线或设施处于临时变化；先读现场替代信息。
glyphs.public_state_en: Rules, route or infrastructure ahead have temporarily changed; read the on-site alternative first.
glyphs.visual_zh: 错位枕木与醒目的版本角标。
glyphs.visual_en: Offset sleepers with a prominent version corner.
glyphs.tactile_zh: 候选可拆式短节律，仅在替代路线完整后铺设。
glyphs.tactile_en: Candidate removable short rhythm, installed only after the alternative route is complete.
glyphs.machine_zh: 版本、有效期和替代状态；过期或冲突即无效。
glyphs.machine_en: Version, validity window and alternative state; expired or conflicting states are invalid.
glyphs.robot_behavior_zh: 停止读取新版本；无法确认时转人工或退出测试区。
glyphs.robot_behavior_en: Stop to read the new version; defer to a human or leave the test area if it cannot be confirmed.
glyphs.failure_behavior_zh: 默认按不可通行处理，并保持无障碍替代路线畅通。
glyphs.failure_behavior_en: Treat as closed by default and keep the accessible alternative clear.
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_zh: 施工状态结束、版本过期、替代路线变化或临时件松动。
glyphs.maintenance_trigger_en: Construction ends, version expires, detour changes or a temporary element loosens.
glyphs.statutory_relationship_zh: 不替代施工围挡、交通组织、公告或临时无障碍设施。
glyphs.statutory_relationship_en: Does not replace work-zone barriers, traffic management, notices or temporary accessible facilities.

fields.role_zh: 多厂商设备共同读码、礼让和天气耐久的标准试验场。
fields.role_en: Standards test field for cross-vendor reading, yielding and weather durability.

fields.role_zh: 残障使用者、儿童、老年人、维护人员与开发者共同修订词典。
fields.role_en: People with disabilities, children, older people, maintainers and developers revise the dictionary together.

fields.role_zh: 研究站点、商业、配送之间最后十米的停靠、交接与临时改道；不据临时几何画站点工程。
fields.role_en: Studies the last ten metres between transit, commerce and delivery—berthing, handover and detours—without using provisional geometry for station engineering.

wings.role_zh: 开放词典、测试工具、合规与国际协作支持。
wings.role_en: Open dictionary, test tools, compliance and international collaboration support.

wings.role_zh: 真实天气、社区使用、蓝绿空间和维护反馈。
wings.role_en: Real weather, community use, blue-green space and maintenance feedback.

landmarks.function_zh: 把“机器先让人”变成沿线最易理解的公共承诺。
landmarks.function_en: Makes “machines yield to people first” the corridor's clearest public commitment.

landmarks.function_zh: 展示六个词、版本、来源、测试结果和公众修订入口。
landmarks.function_en: Displays the six words, version, provenance, test results and public revision channel.

landmarks.function_zh: 以可见、可听但不自动播放的信号确认人机交接完成。
landmarks.function_en: Confirms human-machine handover with visible and user-triggered audible signals, never autoplay.
